skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the formation and development process of SNA, differentiate between various accounts in SNA, and understand their interrelationships.
Classify production branches according to international standards and Vietnamese economic sectors.
Understand basic concepts such as value added, intermediate consumption, final consumption, primary inputs, gross domestic product (GDP).
Construct physical input-output tables from real data, calculate input-output coefficients, and apply these tables for analysis.
Construct value input-output tables from real data, calculate input-output coefficients, and apply these tables for analysis.
Analyze economic relationships using input-output models, including inefficiency testing, environmental economics analysis, productivity growth, and diffusion effects.
Perform matrix calculations using Excel, including matrix multiplication and inversion.
Interpret results from input-output models, present findings through graphs, and explain conclusions.
Conduct research projects in groups, write reports, and make recommendations based on findings.
Develop independent study habits, work effectively in teams, and take responsibility for individual and group work.
Use Microsoft Excel proficiently for data analysis, modeling, and presentation.
